name: rdry-toolrow-contrast
description: an intent-bearing tool row's demoted result line (e.g. "Wrote fizzbuzz.py") must clear WCAG AA (4.5:1) against its pane background, in both themes (kata rdry)

mutation.note: Re-verified after the case picked up styles/global.css (kata e4sh) - its measurement came back byte-identical, but the field attests to a rendering configuration, and that configuration changed. Still fails: dark 3.08:1 and light 3.51:1, both below the 4.5:1 AA floor.
